summary: Constraint solver anchor-offset computation. Transforms the local anchor offset of each rigid body through its rotation matrix (Matrix3x3VectorMultiply), adds the body position to obtain world anchor points, subtracts the two world anchors to get the difference vector, and normalizes it to unit length. The normalized vector is copied back into both body anchor buffers. Used during rigid-body joint/constraint setup by four callers.

local_names.this: constraint joint descriptor holding pointers to two rigid bodies (position, rotation matrix, local anchor buffer)
local_names.v5: body A local anchor buffer (base *(this+8)); input to first transform and write target for the normalized vector
local_names.v2: body B local anchor buffer (base *(this+0x10)); input to second transform and write target for the normalized vector
local_names.v13: world-space difference vector between the two body anchor points
local_names.v12: normalized unit vector of the anchor difference, written back to both anchor buffers

operations.description: First Matrix3x3VectorMultiply: rotate body A's local anchor offset (vector at *(this+8)+0x18) through the rotation matrix at *(this+4)+28 and write the transformed anchor back to *(this+8)+0x18

Second Matrix3x3VectorMultiply: rotate body B's local anchor offset (vector at *(this+0x10)+0x18) through the rotation matrix at *(this+0xC)+28 and write the transformed anchor back to *(this+0x10)+0x18
World anchor B: transformed local anchor components of *(this+0x10) at 0x18/0x20/0x28 added to the body B position components of *(this+0xC) at 0x4/0xC/0x14
World anchor A: transformed local anchor components of *(this+8) at 0x18/0x20/0x28 added to the body A position components of *(this+4) at 0x4/0xC/0x14
Difference vector v13 = world anchor A - world anchor B, component-wise, computed in the v13 buffer
Normalization: v11 = 1.0 / sqrt(dot(v13, v13)); each component of v13 scaled by v11 into the v12 buffer
Write the normalized 0x18-byte vector to *(this+8)+64 and to *(this+0x10)+64, giving both rigid bodies a unit-length anchor separation direction

Return pointer to the body A position (*(this+4)+4). Invoked on the physics frame path by VehiclePhysicsInitializer (00439210), ConstraintForceSolver (0043BA20), VehiclePhysicsJointSystemLoader (0056D930) and BatchProcessingLoop3Passes (0056EC00)
